$description: OSPREY design system primitives. Theme-independent. Colors are never emitted as CSS custom properties directly — referenced one-hop by tokens/themes/*.json and tokens/interfaces/*.json via {color.family.step} aliases. Color ramp steps are NOT a synthetic mathematical scale — each step is a literal hex value that already exists somewhere in the six interfaces' hand-maintained CSS/JS (variables.css, theme-light.css, theme.js XTERM_PALETTES, gallery.js, plots.js, dashboard.js). Step numbers only encode relative lightness (low = light, high = dark) so the ramp is monotonic; gaps between steps are intentional and reflect the real distinct values in use, not a uniform interval. The font/text/weight/leading/space/radius/z/duration scale groups below ARE emitted directly as root-level CSS custom properties (--text-*, --weight-*, ...), once in the default :root block only — themes cannot override them.

slate.$description: Neutral/background/text family. 22 steps because dark-mode and light-mode each accumulated their own hand-tuned bg/text/border shades over time; every step below is a distinct literal from web-terminal's variables.css + theme-light.css (canonical) or theme.js ANSI black/white slots.

teal.$description: OSPREY accent family (fleet-wide accent color per user decision). Includes web-terminal's --color-accent/--color-accent-light plus the ANSI cyan slots (xterm cyan literally is the teal accent).

amber.$description: Hue family behind the accent-secondary role and the warning status. Dark/light diverge because the light themes need a deeper shade for on-light contrast.

350.$description: status.warning / ansi.yellow (dark) — web-terminal redesign frame 2a Grafana yellow

750.$description: status.warning / ansi.yellow (light) — web-terminal redesign frame 2c ochre

400.$description: status.error / ansi.red (dark) — web-terminal redesign frame 2a Grafana red

600.$description: status.error / ansi.red (light) — web-terminal redesign frame 2c Grafana red

green.$description: Success status family plus the welcome-modal's muted sage-green accents (dark theme only — light theme's welcome modal reuses the teal family instead, preserved as-is from source).

350.$description: status.success / ansi.green (dark) — web-terminal redesign frame 2a Grafana green

550.$description: status.success / ansi.green (light) — web-terminal redesign frame 2c Grafana green

blue.$description: ANSI blue family (also tuning's LHS scatter trace color).

violet.$description: ANSI magenta family plus artifacts' memory-domain violet accent (art-violet-* extension tokens).

250.$description: ansi.magenta / violet accent (dark) — web-terminal redesign frame 2a

450.$description: ansi.magenta / violet accent (light) — web-terminal redesign frame 2c

gray.$description: Grafana-style neutral canvas/panel/border/text family for the web-terminal redesign — a flatter, cooler neutral ramp than slate. Dark-mode steps (Panel Designs frames 2a/2c) and light-mode steps (2b/2d) share one monotonic ramp (low = light, high = dark). Referenced one-hop by the redesigned themes; step numbers only encode relative lightness, gaps are intentional.

350.$description: muted text (light) — WCAG-nudged darker from frame #a3a4a6 (2.28:1) to clear the 3:1 gate on the #f4f5f5 canvas (3.27:1)

mono.$description: Pure achromatic ramp (R=G=B at every step) for the high-contrast family. The slate and gray neutrals both carry a deliberate hue cast (slate is blue, gray is Grafana-cool), so neither can express a genuinely black-and-white theme; this family exists so high-contrast can be monochrome by construction rather than by approximation. Steps are 5%-lightness increments, low = light, high = dark — the same monotonic convention as every other family here.

0.$description: pure white — bg.primary (high-contrast light); text.primary/accent (high-contrast dark)

500.$description: the ramp midpoint — the only step that fails both AAA gates against either extreme, so it is used for chrome, never for text

1000.$description: pure black — bg.primary (high-contrast dark); text.primary/accent (high-contrast light)

azure.$description: Grafana-blue accent family — the A/B candidate accent (per the open accent decision, rendered against the teal family). #6e9fff is the dark-theme accent, #1f62c4 the light-theme accent, #e8f1fb the light accent-tint base. Referenced one-hop by the redesigned themes.

cyan.$description: DESY brand cyan family (DESY Styleguide 06/24). #009fdf is the brand cyan ('the primary brand identifier'); #007bc8 is DESY's official screen-accessibility variant for readable colored text on light backgrounds; #0077c4 is that accessibility hex nudged 2 points darker so white-on-accent clears the 4.5:1 AA button gate (#007bc8 scores 4.4995:1 — fails by a hair). Referenced one-hop by the `desy` theme family.

50.$description: terminal selection (desy-light) — solid pale-cyan tint, mirroring light.json's azure.50 pattern

300.$description: DESY brand cyan — accent.base (desy-dark); terminal.ansi.cyan (desy-dark); ansi.bright-cyan + chart series-1 slots (desy-light uses it as the bright variant)

400.$description: DESY accessibility cyan (official styleguide hex) — terminal.ansi.cyan (desy-light)

450.$description: accent.base (desy-light) — WCAG nudge of the official #007bc8, see family description; white accent.on scores 4.73:1 on it

orange.$description: DESY brand orange family (DESY Styleguide 06/24) — the brand's accent colour, mapped onto the accent-secondary semantic slot in the `desy` theme family. #f18f1f is the brand orange; #eb6e0f is DESY's official screen-accessibility variant.

300.$description: DESY brand orange — accent-secondary.base + status.warning (desy-dark); accent-secondary.hover (desy-light)

500.$description: DESY accessibility orange (official styleguide hex) — accent-secondary.hover (desy-dark); accent-secondary.base + status.warning (desy-light)

650.$description: accent-secondary.light (desy-light) — deeper on-light shade, mirroring the main light theme's darker accent-secondary.light slot. Darkened from #c25a0b, which scored only 4.13:1 on desy-light's canvas: this slot carries body text (.text-accent-secondary, .tag-accent-secondary, inline code, the shell's orientation labels), so it is gated at AA 4.5:1 and now clears it at 5.00:1. Same hue as the brand orange, one rung down in lightness — the styleguide's #eb6e0f stays untouched in accent-secondary.base and status.warning.

petrol.$description: Cyan-hued neutral ramp for the `desy` theme family's canvas and text — hue ~203°, taken from DESY dark blue #004a6e (the styleguide's 'black to dark blue' background direction), desaturating toward the light end. Light steps (50–300) are the desy-light canvas; dark steps (750–950) are the desy-dark canvas; mids carry text/border shades for both modes.

display.$description: Fleet-wide display/UI font; canon = web-terminal variables.css. ariel/lattice's '--font-sans: Inter' is retired fleet-wide (Task 3.5/3.6 rename usages to this token).

mono.$description: Sole monospace stack fleet-wide per user decision. Canon = web-terminal variables.css. Retires artifacts' 'DM Mono' and the richer fallback chains ('Fira Code'/'SF Mono'/Consolas) used elsewhere — those interfaces just get JetBrains Mono now.

weight.$description: Font-weight scale, observed web-terminal population (500 x53, 600 x33, 700 x7, 400 x3). Emitted as --weight-*.

leading.$description: Line-height scale, observed web-terminal population (1.5 x15, 1.6 x8, 1 x5, 1.4 x4, 1.3 x3, 1.7 x3). Emitted as --leading-*.

space.$description: Conventional 4px-based scale for component use, emitted as --space-*. No interface currently defines --space-* custom properties (each hand-codes pixel values inline); not extracted from an existing token.

radius.$description: Re-grounded in observed web-terminal radii (3px x50, 4px x27, 2px x7, 6px x3, 8px x5, 12px x1). Emitted as --radius-*; consumed as emitted CSS variables from this commit on.

z.$description: Exact values observed in shipped CSS (web-terminal scaffold.css and others). dropdown < sticky ordering is preserved as-is from source. Emitted as --z-*.

duration.$description: Observed --transition-*/duration values across interfaces, renamed onto one scale (120ms/150ms both folded to distinct steps since both appear as a 'fast' value in different files). Emitted as --duration-*.

text.$description: Type-scale PRIMITIVE (font-size steps) — distinct from the semantic color group also named 'text' in tokens/themes/*.json (bg/text/accent/...). No path collision: this lives under core.json's primitive tree and is emitted as --text-* (2xs/xs/sm/base/...); the semantic 'text.*' color group lives in the theme files and is emitted under different names (--text-primary etc, only primary/secondary/muted steps). Flagged here for the generator/validator author since the shared name is easy to misread. Steps grounded in observed font-size frequency across web-terminal CSS (10px/11px/9px/12px most common); the 7px and 15px singleton outliers are not represented.
